name: Planning Poker
highLevelGoals: The system should enable moderators to efficiently create, manage, and guide Planning Poker games to help development teams collectively set their sprint goals.
The system should allow moderators to add, edit, delete, and view items for estimation, ensuring the estimation process is adaptable to evolving team understanding.
The system should provide tools for moderators to efficiently finalize estimates, including showing estimates, accepting averages, and entering agreed-upon values.
The system should allow moderators to browse, view transcripts, and export previous game data for review and further processing.
The system should enable moderators to create, log in, modify, and delete their accounts securely.
The system should allow moderators to configure time settings and select appropriate estimation scales to suit their team's needs.
The system should allow estimators to join games, view relevant story information, and submit their estimates effectively.
The system should provide estimators with visibility into other participants' estimates and the ability to adjust their own, promoting productive conversations.
The system should provide tools for estimators to manage discussion time, such as starting and resetting countdown timers.
The system should store game results in a non-identifiable way to allow researchers to study estimation patterns and team dynamics.
lowLevelGoals: The moderator can initiate a new Planning Poker game session.
The moderator can send invitations to up to 15 estimators to join the current game session.
The moderator can begin an active Planning Poker game session.
The moderator can conclude an active Planning Poker game session.
The moderator can choose a specific story from the list to be estimated by participants.
The moderator can select a story that has already been estimated and initiate a new estimation round for it.
The moderator can input and add a new user story or item for estimation into the current game.
The moderator can modify the details of an already added story.
The moderator can remove a story from the list of items to be estimated.
The moderator can see a list of all stories currently added to the game for estimation.
The moderator can upload a spreadsheet file to add multiple stories to the game.
The moderator can paste text containing multiple stories directly into the game.
The moderator can reveal the estimates submitted by all participants for the current story.
The moderator can choose to set the final estimate for a story to the calculated average of all submitted estimates.
The moderator can manually input and set a specific value as the final estimate for a story, overriding calculated averages.
The moderator can view a list of all previously conducted Planning Poker games.
The moderator can access and review the detailed log or transcript of a specific completed game.
The moderator can download the data from a completed game in a specified format (e.g., CSV, JSON).
The moderator can permanently remove a completed game and its associated data from the system.
The moderator can register a new user account with moderator privileges.
The moderator can authenticate and gain access to their existing account.
The moderator can update their personal information or account settings.
The moderator can permanently remove their account from the system.
The moderator can request a reminder or reset link for their account password.
The moderator can choose from predefined estimation scales (e.g., Fibonacci, T-shirt sizes) for the game.
The moderator can see the current local timezone displayed within the system.
The estimator can enter an ongoing game session, typically using a game ID or link.
The estimator can see the description and any other relevant information for the story currently being estimated.
The estimator can view the complete list of stories that are part of the current game session.
The estimator can select and submit their chosen estimate for the active story.
The estimator can see the estimates submitted by other participants once they are revealed by the moderator.
The estimator can change their estimate after seeing others' estimates and engaging in discussion.
The estimator can view which participants have submitted their estimates for the current story.
The estimator can receive real-time notifications when other participants submit their estimates.
The estimator can see the estimates given in previous rounds for the current story.
The estimator can navigate through a history of estimates for a story.
The estimator can see a small profile picture or avatar associated with other participants.
The system should maintain a consistent order of estimation cards for the estimator.
The estimator can initiate a two-minute countdown timer to manage the duration of a discussion round.
The estimator can restart the discussion timer if more time is needed for conversation.
The researcher can query and download game data where all personally identifiable information has been removed.
